dataset: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (240)
preprocessing: Raw time-major flat rows staged; unchanged contract applies clip(x,-b,b)/b once. Fixed public design constants: body acceleration 1 g, gyro 1 rad/s, total acceleration 2 g. No empirical bounds or moments. These are not guaranteed archive extrema.
layout: C-order token-major flattening: 128 timesteps x 9 channels; recurrent input [N,128,9]. Last hidden state, hidden 32, linear head of six logits.
split: Official train/test subjects. Sorted 21 TRAIN subjects dealt round-robin into three sites of seven, 2553/2397/2402 windows. Original TEST is read only once after all artifacts and checks complete.

inner_selection.criterion: Maximum final-epoch inner-validation macro OVR AUC; tie chooses lower LR

subject_cell: Released patient contract; subject is the privacy unit, with per-unit gradient clipping AFTER within-subject feature averaging and modal-label pooling. Seven units/site, 21 total. It does NOT average original-window losses or their gradients per subject; that requested task is unsupported without a mechanism change. This cell measures the supported subject-pooled surrogate.
window_cell: Released row contract, per-window clipping, subject-disjoint sites, populations 2553/2397/2402. Mechanism measurement at window level ONLY, not subject protection.
central: Shared once per seed: identical contract-built LSTM/init and public bounds, all 7352 original TRAIN windows, Adam .01, batch256, 20 epochs, optimizer reset each four epochs. No DP, gradient clipping or federation. Ordinary shuffled minibatches; 580 updates. Subject comparison includes pooling/task mismatch.
scoring: One exclusive R3 scoring marker after verifying all 18 federations, 270 node-round captures and three central models. One test load, each model predicted once. No changes or training after scoring; no alternative on low utility.
gap: federated-DP macro-AUC minus paired central macro-AUC; mean and sample SD over three seeds
diagnostics: AUC above .5 and accuracy above training-majority test accuracy, predicted class counts and probability spread: annotations only.
privacy_scope: Budgets are conditional per-training mechanism contracts, separate across eps/seeds/cells. Inner selection uses public non-DP TRAIN data and is not an end-to-end private selection guarantee. No composition claim across campaign.
randomness: Public seeds determine initialization; unchanged node-owned cryptographic noise/sampling retains release semantics; no deterministic noise replacement.
original_run: Preserve all pilot JSON bytes. Pipeline did not learn, evidenced by chance-like central twin and five-step training on 21 modal-labelled subject averages; not a privacy utility finding.
package_changes: None; dsFlower0.5.1 c4eaaf153db4a7204878bf1d8995c16faa615110 and dsFlowerClient0.5.0; canonical runners and mechanisms unchanged.
